715462.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Run this on production, after the release is installed.
  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role) of an organization that already holds an overpaid invoice, meaning an invoice paid more than its amount. Example: one of the 16 overpaid invoices across 13 customer accounts that the requirements (version 11) say production has; the developers can say which accounts they are.
  • Customer A is the customer of that overpaid invoice and also has at least one other open invoice (invoice B).
  • Do not try to make a new overpaid invoice: the app refuses any payment above an invoice's balance.
  • The amounts in the expected result ($100.00 paid $120.00, invoice B $500.00) are an example. Compare with customer A's own amounts.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with the Customer filter showing only customer A ticked.
715462.custom_steps:
1. Read customer A's row.
  2. Read the Totals row and compare it with the row above it, column by column.
